dedupeText: country music album cover aesthetic 90s country soft focus warm lighting denim and leather casual portrait vignette subject centered vertically but offset to the right to balance left aligned text warm skin tones and hair color harmonizing with the sepia toned background high contrast black text with soft drop shadows for legibility against a busy background combine a warm toned soft focus portrait with left aligned high contrast layered typography using a script serif pairing to evoke a classic 90s americana or country music aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, soft-focus portrait of a woman with vibrant red hair sitting cross-legged on a floor, featuring layered typography that combines a stylized display script with a clean serif subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically but offset to the right to balance left-aligned text
Warm skin tones and hair color harmonizing with the sepia-toned background
High-contrast black text with soft drop shadows for legibility against a busy background
coreInvariants: Casual, seated pose with hands clasped around knees
Vignetted edges that draw focus to the center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, seated on the floor, scaled to show full torso and legs.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and vibrant red hair serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down to the clasped hands, then sweep left to the large display typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left side of the frame is relatively open, providing a canvas for the primary text elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and tan tones in the background and floor.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant copper-red hair and cool blue denim jeans.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black and dark blue used for typography and the subject's mesh top.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the hair against a desaturated, low-contrast background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a tall, condensed script with sharp, flared terminals
Secondary text uses a slanted, high-contrast serif with rounded terminals
Heavy use of drop shadows to create depth
characterSpecificRedesigns: Custom kerning to allow letters to overlap slightly
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a sharp, vertical script and a soft, slanted serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the organic, slightly rough edge of the display text
Matches the classic, readable serif style of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus studio portrait of a woman with long, wavy red hair, wearing a black mesh top and light blue jeans, sitting cross-legged on a tan floor against a warm, blurry background. Apply a dark vignette to the edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a large, black, condensed script font at the top left. Add the title in a medium-sized, white, italicized serif font below it. Apply soft black drop shadows to all text for legibility.

verificationChecks: Is the hair color vibrant copper-red?
Is the background sufficiently blurred and warm-toned?
Does the text have a visible drop shadow?
Is the composition balanced between the subject on the right and text on the left?

adjustableVariables: Opacity of the text drop shadows
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the subject's face
Verify the color balance between the blue jeans and warm background
Confirm the drop shadow provides enough contrast for white text on a light background
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned, soft-focus portrait with left-aligned, high-contrast layered typography using a script/serif pairing to evoke a classic 90s Americana or Country music aesthetic.
